restaurant_name: Dog&Duke Animal Clinic สัตวแพทย์ คลีนิกรักษาสัตว์
text:
This vet delayed diagnosis and essential treatment that could have saved the lives of my 2 cats, and then tried to blame me for his mistakes.

At the time, I didn’t know anything about the disease they had and stupidly trusted this vet. The vet delayed diagnosis, gave me the wrong treatment and advice, finally tested one cat and started treatment when the disease was too far advanced. He only tested the other cat after the first had died, by which time it was too late to save him either. They both died from horrendous seizures that I now know could have been avoided.  Afterwards, the vet said I had caused the deaths by mishandling the cats at home, which I had not.  I was incredibly distressed by their horrible, painful deaths, and this man stood in his surgery while I was bloody well crying and actually said that I had caused it.

I have since consulted four other vets in Chiang Mai, all of whom confirmed that any vet would have understood the seriousness of the disease these cats had; would have known perfectly well that testing should be done for all cats if the disease is even suspected, and that all vets know the correct treatment protocol, which needs to be implemented immediately on diagnosis.
When I first took both cats to see him, this vet even suggested that the symptoms might be caused by this disease but assured me not to worry, it probably wasn’t.  I have since found out that both cats should have been tested immediately and treated simultaneously, but instead this man got as much money out of me as possible until the first cat died, then as much money as possible until the second died, and then tried to say that it was my fault. My fault was in not going to another vet immediately to get a second opinion, and in trusting this man to take care of my cats. I have kicked myself for that ever since, because they did not need to die in such an awful way.

Dog & Duke seems to specialize in treating pedigree French bulldogs and I think that any other animals are handled extremely carelessly.  During the treatment the vet wouldn’t replace the IV fluid bag because one of his bulldogs came in and took priority. From the look on his face when we finally got to see him that day, the vet clearly knew he had left it too long and that my boy was dangerously, and as it turned out, fatally dehydrated.  I will say that his receptionist and assistant were very kind - they did everything they could to try to help me, and to get the vet to check on my cat but he really did not care. I should have gone to the hospital but I was panicking and scared to even move him as he was so ill.

There are some very good, honest and caring vets in Chiang Mai. Unfortunately, I really do not believe that this man is one of them. Please consider using another vet, particularly if you have cats.
